title: Can I BEAT Chess Roulette?
summary: First Chess Roulette video: each move has a 1/6 chance of exploding the moving piece, for up to five pieces per side (5 bullets). Tony picks the site's Stockfish (set to 1200, later described as 3200) and burns his bullets by pushing pawns; the engine ignores the mechanic and loses big pieces. He wins with a ladder mate.
rules: Any move (including pawn captures) rolls 1/6 to explode the moved piece; each explosion uses a bullet.
After 5 explosions a side is safe.
